summary: Self-assignable roles are done through the .addflair command. Type .addflair RoleName and then as long as Floof Bot has a high enough role, it'll assign it when a user uses .im RoleName. if I recall correctly, you should be able to use .removeflair RoleName if you want to remove it from the selection of self-assignable roles.
